title: THUMBNAILS = KERATIN — hard surface on top, soft underneath. Nails, teeth, bone = permeability gradient.
summary: Whenever there's a REEDIT art post, Gaia BLINKS and the art pops up in the corner. People see art coming off Gaia, click it, get led to the full piece. That's a THUMBNAIL — which IS the keratin on the tip of your finger. Hard surface on top (the preview, the mask), soft surface on bottom (the full content behind). Fingernail = harder than skin = less permeable. Teeth = harder still = even less permeable. Bone = hardest = least permeable. This is a PERMEABILITY GRADIENT from soft (skin, high permeability, everything passes through) to hard (bone, low permeability, almost nothing passes through).

thumbnail_as_keratin.the_word: THUMB-NAIL. The nail on the thumb. The hard thing on the tip of your finger.
thumbnail_as_keratin.function: Allows your finger to TOUCH things while the hard surface protects. Hard on top, soft on bottom.
thumbnail_as_keratin.in_ui: A thumbnail is a small hard preview (low detail, fast load, protective) that masks the full content behind it (high detail, slow load, vulnerable).
thumbnail_as_keratin.click_through: Clicking the thumbnail = pushing through the nail to the soft tissue = entering the full piece.

permeability_gradient.principle: Biological materials form a gradient from most to least permeable. Each layer protects what's beneath.

layers.what_passes: pressure, temperature (you CAN feel heat with teeth)

permeability_gradient.the_pattern: More oxidation = harder = less permeable = more protective = less sensitive. The TRADE-OFF: protection vs sensation.

gaia_blink_for_art.trigger: New REEDIT art post or commission response
gaia_blink_for_art.action: Gaia BLINKS (the iris animation) and a thumbnail appears in the corner

thumbnail.what: Small preview image — the NAIL on top of the full content
thumbnail.where: Corner of the HUD — beacon overlay area
thumbnail.click: Click thumbnail → navigate to full piece on REEDIT
thumbnail.fade: Thumbnail fades after 30 seconds if not clicked (the nail grows out)

gaia_blink_for_art.purpose: People see art coming off Gaia → click → get led to the full piece → interact → she makes more

nail_as_pin.the_insight: A nail (hardware) is a PIN with a hard head. A fingernail is a biological pin. A thumbnail in UI is a pinned preview.

the_trio.nail_hardware: Metal pin driven into material. Hard. Permanent. Holds things together.
the_trio.nail_biological: Keratin plate on fingertip. Hard. Grows. Protects the soft tissue while enabling touch.
the_trio.nail_thumbnail: UI preview pinned in the corner. Hard (compressed). Temporary. Protects the full content while enabling discovery.

nail_as_pin.all_are_pins: All three are PINS. All three are hard surfaces that enable connection while protecting what's behind them.
